title: 第23章 沼泽地第24章 虫洞
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
[涅盘之剑lv.0（绿色）]
类别：武器
耐久：400400（可修复）
攻击力：50（护甲穿透：30%）
装备需求：无。
装备效果：吸血3%（50级开启），吸血5%（100级开启）。
简介：或许难以想象，但这是唯一一把可以制作的永恒武器。
价格：不可出售。
或许现在涅盘之剑的属性还比不上苏墨之前爆的腥红之月，但涅盘之剑可以升级啊，别拿下限和上限比啊。
剑身如精铁铸造一般，散发着微弱的黄芒，比腥红之月还细一些。
涅盘之剑可以用黄色核心宝石进行升级，可以用核心宝石恢复耐久，至于核心宝石的来源就是通过装备拆解仪拆解装备获得的。
[黄色核心宝石（绿色）]
类别：材料。
简介：用于制作和提升涅盘之剑，每次升级护甲穿透增加0.3%，攻击力增加0~2.2。
价格：不可出售。
涅盘之剑的最高提升等级为100级，前世后期几乎人手一把涅盘，按照理论上，涅盘的攻击可以270（护甲穿透：60%），护甲穿透是一定可以提升至60%。
至于攻击力，前世最高的人也才提升到220，苏墨以前用的一把涅盘攻击力也才160，这还算是运气好的，普遍的满级涅盘攻击力在100左右。
这种武器消耗大量资源，几乎没有人会去培养第二把。
收起思绪，将涅盘放入储物栏，现在没有剑鞘一类的装备，还是不要别在腰上的好。
叫上三人一起，规划了一下区域，将之前移植过来的草根、树苗、浆果丛和树种都种下去，这些东西都是需要有土壤存在的，顺便施了个肥，花瓣和浆果已经成为腐烂物。

苏墨还顺便做了一个冰箱。
【你消耗石砖×1、齿轮×1、金块×2，制作冰箱，已解锁冰箱，精神值+15。
[冰箱（白色）：双倍保鲜，放置在内的食物减缓50%的腐烂速度]
一个冰箱只有9格的空间，将已经变成黄色的怪物肉还有胡萝卜放进去，延缓一下腐烂时间。
忙碌了一个上午，终于决定要出门了，苏墨将摘来的荧光果分了分，集体做了提灯。
【你消耗荧光果×2、草绳×2、树枝×3，制作提灯，已解锁提灯，精神值+15。
苏墨现在已经不需要矿灯帽了，但是提灯还是可以做一个的。
[魔光护符（绿色）]
类别：项坠（同种饰品只能穿戴一种）
耐久：100100（可修复，照亮时间24小时）
装备需求：无。
装备效果：移速+10%，散发光芒点亮周围，避免暗影侵袭。
简介：远古伪科学站的出产物，他们真的开始运用暗影的能量了。
content_en:
[Sword of Nirvana lv.0 (green)]
Category: Weapons
Durability: 400400 (repairable)
Attack power: 50 (Armor penetration: 30%)
Equipment requirements: None.
Equipment effect: 3% blood-sucking (enabled at level 50), 5% blood-sucking (enabled at level 100).
Introduction: It may be hard to imagine, but this is the only eternal weapon that can be crafted.
Price: Not for sale.
Perhaps the attributes of the Nirvana Sword are not as good as Su Mo's previous Red Moon, but the Nirvana Sword can be upgraded. Don't compare the upper limit with the lower limit.
The sword body was made of fine iron, emitting a faint yellow light, thinner than the scarlet moon.
The Sword of Nirvana can be upgraded with yellow core gems, and its durability can be restored with core gems. As for the source of the core gems, it can be obtained by dismantling equipment through the equipment disassembly instrument.
[Yellow Core Gem (Green)]
Category: Material.
Introduction: Used to make and upgrade the Nirvana Sword. Each upgrade increases armor penetration by 0.3% and attack power by 0~2.2.
Price: Not for sale.
The highest upgrade level of the Sword of Nirvana is level 100. In the latter part of the previous life, almost everyone had a Nirvana. According to theory, Nirvana's attack can be 270 (armor penetration: 60%), and the armor penetration can definitely be increased to 60%.
As for the attack power, the highest person in the previous life only had an attack power of 220. The attack power of the Nirvana used by Su Mo before was only 160. This was considered lucky. The general attack power of the full-level Nirvana was around 100.
This kind of weapon consumes a lot of resources, and almost no one will cultivate a second one.
Put away your thoughts and put Nirvana in the storage column. Now that you don’t have any equipment like a scabbard, it’s better not to wear it on your waist.
The three of them were called together to plan the area and plant the grass roots, saplings, berry bushes and tree species that had been transplanted before. These things all require soil. They also applied fertilizer by the way, but the petals and berries had become rotten matter.
Su Mo also made a refrigerator by the way.
[You consume stone bricks × 1, gears × 1, and gold nuggets × 2 to make a refrigerator. The refrigerator has been unlocked, and the spiritual value is +15.
[Refrigerator (white): Double preservation, food placed inside slows down the decay rate by 50%]
A refrigerator only has 9 spaces. Put the monster meat and carrots that have turned yellow into it to delay the decay time.
After a busy morning, Su Mo finally decided to go out. Su Mo divided the fluorescent fruits he picked into pieces and made a lantern together.
[You consume fluorescent fruit ×2, straw rope ×2, and tree branches ×3 to make a lantern. The lantern has been unlocked, and the spiritual value is +15.
Su Mo no longer needs a miner's lamp cap, but he can still make a lantern.
[Magic Light Amulet (Green)]
Category: Pendant (only one type of jewelry of the same type can be worn)
Durability: 100100 (repairable, lighting time 24 hours)
Equipment requirements: None.
Equipment effect: Movement speed +10%, emits light to light up the surroundings, and avoids shadow invasion.
Introduction: A product of the ancient pseudoscience station, they really started to use the power of shadow.
